modalities.evidence: T1w, T2w, DTI, susceptibility-weighted image, angiography

output.population: 37 participants, ages 15–35; the text describes 20 participants scanned at 7 Tesla
output.summary: High-field functional MRI recorded during prolonged stimulation with an auditory feature film, plus anatomical, diffusion, susceptibility-weighted and angiography scans and noise measurements. Combines four formerly separate OpenfMRI datasets in BIDS format.
